<!-- sideload-note -->
Sideload build. Android will warn about installing from an unknown source, that is expected for anything not distributed through a store.

**Read-only.** This app never clears a code, runs an actuator test, or writes to an ECU.

INF sub-code reading through an ELM327-compatible adapter is confirmed on a Gen2 Prius. No laptop or proprietary dealer diagnostic software is required. BETSY explains only documented DTC/sub-code pairs and leaves unknown or ambiguous combinations unresolved rather than guessing. Treat any diagnostic result as guidance, not a repair verdict.
